RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday,  the February 26, 2007/Phalguna 7, 1928 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Earth Sciences; Food Processing Industries; Human Resource
Development; Law and Justice; Mines; Minority Affairs; New and Renewable
Energy; Power; Science and Technology; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Tribal Affairs; Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 20
IIT in Andhra Pradesh
*1. SHRI NANDI YELLAIAH: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether his Ministry has considered
the proposal of Andhra Pradesh
Government for establishment of an IIT at
Basara in Adilabad district of Andhra
Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details of the proposal and
the action taken thereon, indicating the
amount sanctioned for this purpose;
(c) whether, on the recommendation of
an expert Committee constituted by
Andhra Pradesh Government, the Union
Government propose to upgrade Osmania
University College of Engineering and
Technology and Andhra Pradesh College
of Engineering to IIT status;
(d) if so, by when; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Power generation by 2020
*2. SHRI DARA SINGH: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have the
capacity to generate 21,180 Megawatts of
electricity by 2020, under its calculated
power programme;
(b) whether the Department of Atomic
Energy (DAE) had also submitted certain
proposals in this regard to the Committee
of Secretaries in early December, 2006; and
(c) if so, the number of proposals
examined by the said Committee and what
is the outcome thereof?
Begging by children
†*3. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the fact that thousands of children in the
country are either engaged in begging or
being used as means of begging;
(b) the steps taken by Government to
protect them from such exploitation;
(c) whether Government are aware that
several anti-social organisations are engaged
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

2
in these activities who torture these
innocent children after kidnapping and
make them source of their income by
forcing them to beg; and
(d) the measures taken by Government
to salvage these tiny kids from such in-
human and exploitating situation and
whether these measures have proved to be
effective; if so, the details thereof?
Validity of laws placed in the Ninth
Schedule of the Constitution
*4. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
SHRI AMAR SINGH:
Will the Minister of LAW AND
JUSTICE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
review the Constitution of India in the wake
of recent Supreme Court order which lays
down that all laws placed in the Ninth
Schedule after 1973 would be open to
judicial review;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, in what manner Government
propose to resolve the reservation
policy of Tamil Nadu Government which
has made reservation to the extent of 69
per cent?
Increase in the number of
Anganwadis
*5. SHRI K.E. ISMAIL: Will the
Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Supreme
Court has ordered Government to take
measures to increase the number of
Anganwadis from the present six lakhs to
fourteen lakhs in a phased manner by 2008
in order to realize the commitment made in
the Common Minimum Programme of UPA
Government to universalize the ICDS
Scheme;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
measures being taken by Government;
(c) whether it is a fact that some State
Governments have failed to implement the
earlier orders of the Supreme Court in this
regard; and
(d) if so, which are the States lagging
behind in implementing the ICDS Scheme
and what action is being taken against these
States?
Prestigious educational institutions
in different States
*6. SHRI PYARIMOHAN MOHA-
PATRA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of Centrally funded
prestigious educational institutions like IIT,
IIM, IIIT and Central Universities
etc., located in different States,
State-wise;
(b) the reasons for not establishing a
single such institution in Orissa over the
last 60 years since Independence;
(c) the norms for establishing such
institutions adopted for the Eleventh Five
Year Plan; and
(d) the reasons for not considering
Orissa as a location inspite of the need to
support the State’s ambitious industrial
development programme as well as
education of nearly 40 per cent tribal and
SC population of the State?

SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA:
Will the Minister of WOMEN AND
CHILD DEVELOPMENT be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the NHRC report lists
nearly 45000 children going missing every
year in the country;
(b) whether according to the report,
most children are reported missing from
the State

to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

Energy; Power; Science and Technology; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Tribal Affairs; Women and Child Development)
Total number of questions — 130
1
Installation of wealther forecast
stations
1. SHRI B.J. PANDA: Will the Minister
of EARTH SCIENCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is proposed to install 200
automatic weather forecast stations in the
Eastern India;
(b) if so, the details thereof inter-alia
indicating those that are proposed to be
installed in Orissa; and
(c) whether the action plan will provide
comprehensive forecasting on frequent
intervals to the coastal people to control
large-scale destruction in this region?
Power generation from sea water
†2. SHRI AMIR ALAM KHAN: Will
the Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have
conducted any survey for generating power
from sea water;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any cost analysis has been
made in this regard;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) whether Government are
contemplating to implement any project
for commercial power generation from
marine water;
(f) if so, the name of the organisation
proposed to be associated with the project
of commercial power generation; and
(g) the financial assistance being
provided by Government for the purpose?
Capacity of cold storage and
processing units
3. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have prepared
any action plan to increase the capacity of
existing cold storage and food processing units
in the country including Andhra Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of such units in the States
as on date  and Government propose to set
up during 2005-06 in the country, State-
wise; and

2
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) the funds allocated for the purpose
during the current financial year?
Preservation of fruits and vegetables
4. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
FOOD PROCESSING INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that fruits and
vegetables are preserved in the cold storage
for maintaining the freshness by using
medicines;
(b) if so, whether Government have
made any survey of these cold storage and
found any contaminations;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) the steps taken by Government to
maintain quality of food and vegetables;
and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Import of processed food items
5. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of FOOD PROCESSING
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
import of processed food items is adversely
affecting indigenous food processing
industries;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the names of those Indian companies
which are using brand name of foreign
companies for their processed food items;
and
(d) the action taken, if any, against such
companies?
Percentage of school going
children
†6. SHRI JAI PARKASH
AGGARWAL: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it has been brought out in
the annual status report regarding education
that there has been no change in the
percentage of school going children in the
age group of 6-14 years in the country
during the last two years;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government have taken any
steps to bring change in the percentage of
children in the lower age group; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Literacy for poverty alleviation
7. SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY: Will the Minister of
HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that literacy has
to be integral to any strategy for poverty
alleviation as it is the single hurdle on the
path to empowerment of the poor;
(b) if so, the comments of Government
thereon;
(c) the aims and objectives set for the
coming decade;
(d) whether Government are making
sustained efforts to cover every illiterate,
gender-wise; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

3
Making AICTE helpful to applicants
8. SHRI S.M. LALJAN BASHA: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether any steps are proposed to
make the AICTE open and helpful to all
applicants for various approvals;
(b) whether it is a fact that there is a
communication gap generally between the
AICTE and applicant institutions;
(c) what steps Government would
initiate to make the AICTE
administratively strong so as to become
accessible and open with all institutes having
technical courses; and
(d) the steps proposed in this regard?
IIT in Orissa

MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMEN
